level_one.title: Mana Addict
level_one.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Kael'thas's maximum Mana by 15.  Reward: After gathering 20 Globes, Kael'thas can activate Arcane Barrier to gain a Shield equal to 100% of his maximum Mana for 4 seconds. 45 second cooldown.

level_four.title: Nether Wind
level_four.description: Increases Gravity Lapse's range by 30%. When Gravity Lapse hits an enemy Hero, refund 80 Mana.

level_seven.title: Burned Flesh
level_seven.description: When Flamestrike damages 2 or more Heroes, they take additional damage equal to 8% of their maximum Health.

level_ten.title: Pyroblast
level_ten.description: After 1.5 seconds, cast a slow-moving fireball that deals 810 (+5% per level) damage to an enemy Hero and 405 (+5% per level) damage to enemies nearby.

level_thirteen.title: Pyromaniac
level_thirteen.description: Each time Living Bomb deals periodic damage, Kael'thas's Basic Ability cooldowns are reduced by 0.5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Fury of the Sunwell
level_sixteen.description: Flamestrike will explode a second time 1.5 seconds later.

level_one.title: Free Drinks
level_one.description: When Healing Brew heals a Hero under 50% Health, its cooldown is reduced by 1 second, and its Mana cost is refunded.

level_four.title: Wind Serpent
level_four.description: Cloud Serpent grants its bearer 10% increased Movement Speed. Casting Blinding Wind increases this bonus to 20% for 3 seconds.  Passive: Cloud Serpent attacks 25% faster.

level_seven.title: Let's Go!
level_seven.description: Activate to heal an allied Hero for 160 (+4% per level) and make them Unstoppable for 1 second. Let's Go's cooldown is affected by Fast Feet.  Cannot be used on Li Li.

level_ten.title: Jug of 1,000 Cups
level_ten.description: Channel for up to 6 seconds. Every 0.25 seconds, increase the cooldown of Jug of 1,000 Cups by 2 seconds, up to 50 additional seconds, and heal the lowest Health nearby allied Hero for 75 (+4% per level) Health.

level_thirteen.title: Gale Force
level_thirteen.description: Increase Blinding Wind's Blind duration by 0.75 seconds. Li Li's Basic Attacks against Blinded Heroes deal 100% increased damage.

level_sixteen.title: Two For One
level_sixteen.description: Increases the number of allies healed by Healing Brew to 2, but increases the cooldown by 1 second.

level_one.title: Patchwork Creation
level_one.description: Gain 3 Armor for every unit afflicted with Vile Gas, stacking up to 8 times. While Shambling Horror is active, this Armor amount is doubled.  Passive: Increase regeneration effects and all healing received by 15%.

level_four.title: Tenderizer
level_four.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes Slow by 20% for 1.5 seconds and restore 1.75% of Stitches' maximum Health.

level_seven.title: Serrated Edge
level_seven.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook deals bonus damage equal to 5% of their maximum Health, reduces Hook's cooldown by 4 seconds, and restores 35 Mana.

level_ten.title: Gorge
level_ten.description: Consume an enemy Hero, trapping them for 4 seconds. When Gorge ends, the enemy Hero takes 274 (+4% per level) damage. The trapped Hero cannot move or act and doesn't take damage from other sources.

level_thirteen.title: Meat Hook
level_thirteen.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook heals Stitches for 20% of his maximum Health over 5 seconds. While active, Basic Attacks against the Hero hit refresh the duration of this effect.

level_sixteen.title: Pulverize
level_sixteen.description: All enemies hit by Slam are Slowed by 70% for 0.75 seconds and Heroes have their Armor reduced by 10 for 3 seconds.

level_one.title: Fealty Unto Death
level_one.description: When a nearby friendly or enemy Minion dies, Leoric restores 32 (+4% per level) Health and 6 Mana.

level_four.title: Kneel, Peasants!
level_four.description: Skeletal Swing deals 75% additional damage to Mercenaries and Monsters, and hitting them activates Skeletal Swing's cost and cooldown refund.

level_seven.title: Drain Momentum
level_seven.description: Drain Hope no longer reduces Leoric's Movement Speed. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, gain 30% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Entomb
level_ten.description: Create an unpassable tomb for 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Spectral Leech
level_thirteen.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage to the primary target damage equal 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health and heal Leoric for 200% of the bonus damage dealt.

level_sixteen.title: Mithril Mace
level_sixteen.description: Increase Leoric's Attack Speed by 20%.  Repeatable Quest: Nearby enemy Minion deaths grant 0.3% permanent Attack Speed, and Takedowns grant 3% permanent Attack Speed, up to 30%.

level_one.title: Ace in the Hole
level_one.description: Deal 12% more damage to Stunned or Slowed Heroes.  Enemy Heroes hit by Give 'Em Some Pepper are Slowed by 10% for 2.5 seconds.

level_four.title: Behemoth Armor
level_four.description: Gain 200 bonus maximum Health.   Quest: Every time Give 'Em Some Pepper's primary target is a Hero, gain an additional 8 maximum Health.

level_seven.title: Unstable Compound
level_seven.description: Increase the radius of Give 'Em Some Pepper by 15%. Each enemy Hero hit by Give 'Em Some Pepper grants Raynor 10 Mana and reduces the cooldown of Penetrating Round by 1.5 seconds.

level_ten.title: Hyperion
level_ten.description: Order the Hyperion to make a strafing run for 12 seconds, hitting up to 4 enemies for 66 (+4% per level) damage every second. Every 4 seconds, it can fire its Yamato Cannon at a Structure, dealing 794 (+4% per level) damage.

level_thirteen.title: Give Me More!
level_thirteen.description: While Inspire is active, gain 1 Basic Attack range.  Passive: Increase Adrenaline Rush duration by 0.5 seconds, increasing the total amount healed by 12.5% of Raynor's maximum Health.

level_sixteen.title: Rallying Cry
level_sixteen.description: Increase the Attack Speed bonus of Inspire by 20%.  Passive: After every 12 Basic Attacks, cast Inspire for free.

level_one.title: Creed of the Hunter
level_one.description: Quest: Every 50 Basic Attacks against Heroes increases Hatred's damage bonus per stack by 1%, up to 6%.  Gambit: Gain 25% bonus Attack Speed. Every death reduces this bonus by 5%.

level_four.title: Death Dealer
level_four.description: Increase Vaults Basic Attack damage bonus from 6% to 15% per stack of Hatred. If this attack kills its victim within 1.5 seconds, the Mana cost and cooldown of Vault are refunded.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Vault by 5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Hot Pursuit
level_seven.description: Increase the Movement Speed bonus of each stack of Hatred from 1% to 2%.

level_ten.title: Rain of Vengeance
level_ten.description: Launch a wave of Shadow Beasts that deals 250 (+4% per level) damage and Stuns enemies in the target area for 0.5 seconds.  Stores up to 2 charges.

level_thirteen.title: Tempered by Discipline
level_thirteen.description: Basic Attacks heal for 10% of the damage dealt, increased by 2% per Hatred stack.

level_one.title: Zealous Glare
level_one.description: Shield Glare gains 1 additional charge, and deals 70% more damage.

level_four.title: Eternal Retaliation
level_four.description: Mark enemies hit by Condemn for 10 seconds. Johanna's next Basic Attack against them removes the mark, lowering the cooldown of Condemn by 1 second, refunding 10 Mana, and killing Minions.

level_seven.title: Conviction
level_seven.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed, increased to 20% while Condemn is charging up.

level_ten.title: Blessed Shield
level_ten.description: Deal 114 (+4% per level) damage and Stun the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. Blessed Shield then bounces to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 57 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Blessed Hammer
level_thirteen.description: Activate to create 2 hammers that spiral outward from Johanna, dealing 65 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit. Damaging enemies with Basic Abilities reduce the cooldown of this Ability by 2.5 seconds.  Passive: Every 3rd Basic Attack against enemy Heroes releases a hammer.

level_one.title: Searing Light
level_one.description: Ray of Heaven also deals damage to enemy Heroes in the area equal to 30% of the energy consumed.

level_four.title: Repeated Offense
level_four.description: Enemies hit by Detainment Strike are knocked back 30% farther.  Quest: Every time Detainment Strike stuns a Hero, increase the stun damage by 10, up to 60.  Reward: After stunning 6 Heroes, increase this damage bonus to 250.

level_seven.title: Energized Cord
level_seven.description: Increases the energy stored from Auriel's Basic Attacks to 130% of the damage against Heroes and 70% of the damage against non-Heroes.  Does not affect Auriel's Bestow Hope ally.  Passive: Increase Basic Attack Range by 1.1.

level_ten.title: Crystal Aegis
level_ten.description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.

level_thirteen.title: Converging Force
level_thirteen.description: Enemies hit by the outer area are pushed slightly toward the center.

level_one.title: Pursuit of Flame
level_one.description: Quest: Hit 30 enemy Heroes with Fel Flame without dying.  Reward: Permanently increase Fel Flame's area by 33%.

level_four.title: Consume Soul
level_four.description: Instantly kill an enemy Minion and heal for 365 (+4% per level) Health.  Stores up to 3 charges.

level_seven.title: Bound by Shadow
level_seven.description: Each enemy Hero hit with Fel Flame reduces the cooldown of Corruption by 1.75 seconds.

level_ten.title: Horrify
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 120 (+4% per level) damage to enemy Heroes in an area and Fear them for 2 seconds. While Feared, Heroes are Silenced and are forced to run away from Horrify's center.

level_thirteen.title: Fel Armor
level_thirteen.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Fel Flame grants 50 Spell Armor for 2.5 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 50%.

level_one.title: Maelstrom Weapon
level_one.description: Quest: Basic Attack Heroes while Windfury's Movement Speed bonus is active.  Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, increase the Movement Speed bonus of Windfury to 40% and Thrall's Basic Attacks deal 40 additional damage.  Reward: After hitting 55 Heroes, Thrall permanently gains 15% increased Movement Speed and his Basic Attacks gain an additional 75 damage.  Mythic Reward: After hitting 100 Heroes, Frostwolf Resilience healing restores 200% more Health.

level_four.title: Mana Tide
level_four.description: Frostwolf Resilience restores 15 Mana and reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Rolling Thunder
level_seven.description: Passive: Chain Lightning bounces an additional time.  For 8 seconds after hitting an enemy with Chain Lightning, Thrall's next Basic Attack against them grants a stack of Frostwolf Resilience. If the target is an enemy Hero, then he also deals damage to them equal to 3% of their maximum Health and healing for the same amount.

level_ten.title: Earthquake
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, summon a massive Earthquake that pulses every 4 seconds. Each pulse lasts 2 seconds, Slowing all enemies in the area by 50%, and deals 50 (+4% per level) damage to enemy Heroes. Does 3 pulses.

level_thirteen.title: Frostwolf's Grace
level_thirteen.description: Frostwolf Resilience can be activated to instantly heal. This healing is increased by up to 100% based on Thrall's missing health.
